definitions.gloss: good quality, high quality, fine quality
definitions.explanation: Of superior quality. Used to describe materials, products, content, or services that are of a high standard. Functions both as a noun and as a modifier with な or の.

examples.japanese: {良質|りょうしつ}な⟦{睡眠|すいみん}→睡眠：03359_suimin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧とりたい。
examples.english: I want to get good quality sleep.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{良質|りょうしつ}な⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{恵|めぐ}まれている→恵まれる：12619_megumareru⟧。
examples.english: This area is blessed with high-quality water.

examples.japanese: {良質|りょうしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧たんぱく⟦{質|しつ}→質：01425_shitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{含|ふく}む→含む：01982_fukumu⟧⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{意識的|いしきてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{選|えら}んでいる→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: I consciously choose foods that contain high-quality protein.

notes:
USAGE:
Can be used with either な or ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ as a modifier: {良質|りょうしつ}な⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧ or {良質|りょうしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧ (high-quality material). Both are natural, though な is slightly more common.

The opposite is ⟦{粗悪|そあく}→粗悪：18175_soaku⟧ (inferior quality) or ⟦{低品質|ていひんしつ}→低品質：23685_teihinshitsu⟧ (low quality). Compared to ⟦{高品質|こうひんしつ}→高品質：18051_kouhinshitsu⟧ (high-quality), {良質|りょうしつ} sounds slightly warmer and less technical.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {良質|りょうしつ}な⟦{睡眠|すいみん}→睡眠：03359_suimin⟧: quality sleep
- {良質|りょうしつ}な⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧: high-quality materials
- {良質|りょうしつ}な⟦コンテンツ→コンテンツ：06234_kontentsu⟧: quality content
- {良質|りょうしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧たんぱく⟦{質|しつ}→質：01425_shitsu⟧: high-quality protein
